_doc: Cost-optimized write saturation (AGENTS.md §7 + Fleet cost levers). Combines: (1) batch=50 records/POST — ~35x more records/s per client vCPU, so far fewer pods; (2) n2d-highcpu-32 fleet (cheaper, low-RAM — pool client is CPU-bound); (3) a TIGHTER NVMe server c4d-standard-16-lssd (SERVER_CPUS=16), since the 32-core server only used ~25 cores at saturation. connections + pod_ladder here are a STARTING POINT — re-calibrate single-pod max at batch=50/fleet_cpu=2 (it changes the knee) before trusting the ladder; the orchestrator's calibration phase does this.
